message.content: What is the compiled pattern for a failure message in a graph constraint system when checking for forbidden nodes in the 'failOn' category for rule number 42?

function.name: RegexConstraint_initIRPattern
function.description: Initializes and compiles a regex Pattern based on the category of the constraint and the index of the rule. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

category.description: The category of the constraint, which determines the pattern to be compiled. This is Java String type parameter in string representation.

ruleIdx.description: The index of the rule for which the pattern is being compiled. This is Java integer type parameter in string representation.
